hint_text: Recall the following concepts that may be relevant: extract objects may be relevant. recolor object means recolor an object based on a color scheme. draw object means draw a sprite on top of a base grid, drawing over the base grid with the sprite's non-background pixels. create new grid means create a new grid with specified dimensions, initialized with a fill color. is color criteria means condition on whether an object is a given color. find object means find an object in a list of objects based on some criteria. draw line means draw a line between two pixels in a grid, updating the grid accordingly. filter objects means filter a list of objects based on some criteria. crop around objects means create a new grid that is a contiguous sub region of the input grid, containing the minimum bounding box of the specified objects. sort objects means sort a list of objects according to a key function, often used to order objects spatially.
